<thought>After retrieving template 1914384, its retrosynthetic transformation disconnects the target molecule into two fragments: a carbonyl fragment (a CF₃‑substituted carbonyl compound) and an alkenyl‑aryl fragment. Applying this template to the target yields the two precursor SMILES:
1. C(=O)C(F)(F)F – the carbonyl fragment bearing the CF₃ group.
2. C=CH‑c1ccccc1 – the vinyl‑phenyl fragment.

These precursors can be commercially obtained, providing a valid retrosynthetic route that uses the required template 1914384.

The route in the required JSON format is:
{
  "type": "mol",
  "smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1914384,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C(=O)C(F)(F)F"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C=CHc1ccccc1"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
